security_audit.summary: Most static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown fenced examples. The skill still contains high-risk credential vault workflows, including private keys and decrypted credential sharing, so secret handling should be removed or constrained before publication.

remediation.issue: Credential vault workflow asks users to store and retrieve raw secrets.
remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions to paste, display, decrypt, or return API keys, database passwords, OAuth tokens, financial access, private keys, and customer credentials in chat.

remediation.issue: Credential sharing examples could normalize disclosure of sensitive access.
remediation.suggestion: Replace sharing flows with references to an external secrets manager that enforces authorization, MFA, audit logs, and scoped access outside the AI transcript.

remediation.issue: Security claims are described without an implementation boundary.
remediation.suggestion: State that the skill is advisory only and cannot provide encryption, key custody, rotation, or access control unless backed by a reviewed integration.

content.user_title: Manage Founder Operations and Business Signals
content.value_statement: Founders need one place to organize ventures, metrics, credentials, and strategic reviews. Founder OS provides structured workflows for portfolio tracking, signal reviews, vault planning, and decision support.
actual_capabilities: Defines workflows for registering, updating, listing, and archiving founder ventures.
Organizes business signals such as revenue, growth, engagement, team, and runway metrics.
Provides snapshot formats for health scores, SWOT reviews, forecasts, and recommended actions.
Guides strategic decision analysis for hiring, market expansion, fundraising, and pivots.
Documents vault-related workflows for credential storage, retrieval, sharing, and rotation.
Lists triggers, command examples, error handling, and Version 1 scope boundaries.
limitations: The skill is documentation only and does not include executable storage or analytics code.
Credential handling requires a separate reviewed vault service before real secrets are used.
Financial forecasts and health scores depend on user-provided data quality.
Recommendations remain advisory and do not replace founder approval or professional advice.

use_cases.title: Track a Multi-Venture Portfolio
use_cases.description: Create a consistent view of active, paused, and exited ventures with stages, markets, teams, and status.

use_cases.title: Prepare Monthly Strategic Reviews
use_cases.description: Summarize business health, key metrics, risks, opportunities, forecasts, and next actions for leadership review.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Major Business Decisions
use_cases.description: Compare hiring, expansion, partnership, or pivot options with tradeoffs, risks, costs, and expected outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Register a Venture
prompt_templates.prompt: Register a new business in Founder OS. Ask me for the name, industry, stage, founders, team size, target market, website, and current status.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Health Snapshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a weekly health snapshot for my business. Use revenue, growth, engagement, team, runway, and market signals. Highlight gaps in the data.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Strategic Choice
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether we should enter a new market. Compare costs, timeline, risks, team capacity, expected upside, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Portfolio Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a monthly review across all ventures. Rank business health, identify urgent issues, compare opportunities, and propose founder-approved next steps.

output_examples.output: A portfolio summary grouped by venture status, stage, industry, health score, recent signals, and items needing founder attention.

output_examples.input: Should we hire a VP Sales this quarter?
output_examples.output: A decision brief with current runway, salary impact, revenue assumptions, hiring risks, alternatives, and a recommendation requiring founder approval.

output_examples.input: Generate a monthly snapshot for TechStartup Inc.
output_examples.output: A business review covering executive summary, health score, metric trends, SWOT analysis, risks, opportunities, forecast, and next actions.

best_practices: Provide current metrics, dates, and context before requesting analysis.
Keep founder approval explicit for strategic decisions and operational changes.
Use a separate secrets manager for credentials and avoid pasting raw secrets into chat.
anti_patterns: Do not treat AI recommendations as automatic business decisions.
Do not enter private keys, passwords, OAuth tokens, or financial access details in prompts.
Do not rely on forecasts when source metrics are stale, estimated, or incomplete.

faq.question: What does Founder OS help manage?
faq.answer: It helps structure founder portfolio data, business signals, health snapshots, strategic reviews, and vault workflow planning.

faq.question: Does this skill connect to live financial systems?
faq.answer: No. The documented Version 1 scope excludes real-time financial integrations such as Stripe data feeds.

faq.question: Can it make business decisions automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that all strategic decisions require founder approval and remain advisory.

faq.question: Is it safe to paste credentials into prompts?
faq.answer: No. Use an external secrets manager and avoid placing raw secrets in an AI transcript.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What inputs improve snapshot quality?
faq.answer: Current revenue, growth, engagement, runway, team, customer, and market data improve the quality of the analysis.
